name: bubble
useFor: Use inside Message for a conversation with an agent: default (blue, align end) for what the person sends, secondary for the agent's replies, tinted for another agent, muted for a system note, outline for a quote, destructive for a message that failed, ghost for long output without a box. Group consecutive bubbles with BubbleGroup so only the last keeps its tail.
constraints: More than two bubble colors in one thread
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the blue key (agentcard-website .v7-btn-primary), the quiet gray and paper grounds and the cards' 12px corners
